Each case corresponds to a component. By default the case name must match the component’s technical name in Storyblok:

code: struct Hero: Decodable { let title: String }
struct Article: Decodable { let headline: String }

inlineContent.text: Content fields are named by key path, which resolves to the name Storyblok knows the field by and adds the

A field’s Swift type picks its ordering: a whole number is ordered numerically, a decimal likewise, and everything else as text, which is also the right ordering for an ISO-8601 date. Storyblok serialises a number field as text, though, so a field holding a number may be modelled as a
. Its type cannot settle the ordering, so

code: query.sort(by: \.price, as: .wholeNumber)  // content.price:asc:int, price being a String
